children.default: Buy online pick up in store, from click to handover

children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.help_text: Optional. One or two sentences under the heading.
children.default: The OMS shows real-time store stock on the product page, so shoppers pick a store that has the item and collect it the same day. Store teams get an alert, get the order ready, and hand it over, and when a store is short, the order ships there instead of being canceled.
